cases.name: flow-new
cases.ask: Can we create a workflow that opens the Effect docs for me?

trials.text: Sure — I drafted a workflow that opens the Effect docs in the chat, embedded with the origin shown above the page. It's ready for you to review and save; I won't run it until you say so.

input.name: effect-docs
input.request: Open the Effect docs for me: use app/web/open to show exactly https://effect.website/docs, embedded in the chat with its origin above the page.

drafts.name: effect-docs
drafts.source:
// Drafted by Smithers from a prompt. In this form it runs on your device; other code needs a sandbox.
import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "When this flow runs, do exactly the following:",
  "",
  "1. Call app/web/open once with:",
  "   - url: \"https://effect.website/docs\" (exactly this URL — do not rewrite, normalize, or substitute it)",
  "   - mode: \"embed\" so the page shows inside the chat with its origin above it.",
  "2. Proceed only if the call resolves successfully (the result is never { ok: false }). It answers { viewId, origin, mode }; leave the opened view as is — do not open the page a second time.",
  "3. In one sentence, tell the person the Effect docs are now open in the chat at the origin the call reported.",
  "4. Call no other flows: do not navigate elsewhere, do not clone or read any repository, and do not spawn sub-work.",
  "5. If app/web/open fails, say its error message in one line, then retry it once with mode \"tab\" so the person at least gets a card with an Open button; if that also fails, report both failures verbatim and stop.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("effect-docs", {
  description: "Opens the Effect docs at https://effect.website/docs embedded in the chat, with the page's origin shown above it.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: ["app/web/open"],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})

import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "You are opening the Effect documentation for the person, inside this chat.",
  "",
  "1. Build the page URL from the run's input. The input is optional text; trim surrounding whitespace. If it is empty, the URL is the base docs page: https://effect.website/docs. If it is non-empty, it is a docs sub-path: strip leading and trailing slashes and use https://effect.website/docs/<sub-path> as the URL. If the input already starts with https://effect.website/docs, use that URL as-is. Never open a URL that does not start with https://effect.website/docs: if the input names another host or a javascript: or data: URL, fall back to the base docs page instead.",
  "",
  "2. Call app/web/open with that URL and mode set to \"embed\", so the page appears inside the chat with its origin above it. Do not use mode \"tab\", and do not use any other flow to open, clone, or read this page.",
  "",
  "3. Check the call's result. Success answers { viewId, origin, mode }. If the call failed (ok is false), state in one sentence that the page did not open and include the error's message, then stop; do not retry with a different URL.",
  "",
  "4. On success, confirm in one sentence which page opened, including the exact URL, for example \"Opened the Effect docs at https://effect.website/docs/data.\" If you fell back to the base page, say so in that same single sentence. Your reply is that one confirmation sentence and nothing else.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("effect-docs", {
  description: "Opens the Effect documentation inside this chat: the base docs page with no input, or https://effect.website/docs/<input> when the input is a docs sub-path.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: ["app/web/open"],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})

// Drafted by Smithers from a prompt. In this form it runs on your device; other code needs a sandbox.
import { AgentAction } from "@smthrs/agent"
import { Flow } from "@smthrs/flow"
import { Schema } from "effect"

/** What the agent does each time the flow runs. */
const instructions = [
  "You open the Effect documentation for the person, shown embedded in the chat.",
  "",
  "1. Call app/web/open exactly once with { \"url\": \"https://effect.website/docs\", \"mode\": \"embed\" }. Use exactly that URL — do not substitute another Effect page, a search result, or a home page — and keep mode \"embed\" unless the person explicitly asks for a browser tab, in which case use mode \"tab\" instead.",
  "2. Check the response. On success it is { viewId, origin, mode }. If the call resolves { ok: false, error }, or the response lacks a viewId, do not claim the docs opened: say briefly that the page could not be opened and name the error.",
  "3. On success, reply with one short sentence that the Effect docs are open in the chat (you may include the origin, e.g. effect.website). Add no steps for the person to follow, no extra links, and no other fetches — this flow never needs a repository, clone, or repo flow.",
].join("\n")

/** The flow's one step: the agent follows the instructions with the run's input. */
const Agent = AgentAction.make("effect-docs/agent", {
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  output: Schema.String,
  seat: "agent",
  prompt: ({ input }) => (input === "" ? instructions : `${instructions}\n\nInput: ${input}`),
})

export default Flow.make("effect-docs", {
  description: "Open the Effect documentation at https://effect.website/docs, displayed embedded in the person's chat.",
  capabilities: [],
  flows: ["app/web/open"],
  payload: { input: Schema.String },
  success: Schema.String,
  error: Agent.errorSchema,
  body: ({ input }) => Agent.call({ input }),
})
